question: Which country topped the World Press Freedom Index, 2025, released by Reporters Without Borders (RSF)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Norway**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Norway has consistently ranked as the top country in the World Press Freedom Index, reflecting its strong commitment to freedom of the press and protection of journalists.
 
• The World Press Freedom Index is published annually by Reporters Without Borders (RSF) to assess the state of journalism and media freedom worldwide.
 
• Norway's top ranking is attributed to its robust legal and institutional frameworks that guarantee the independence of the press and safeguard freedom of expression.
